newsitem.title: USA: Marsh & McLennan splits stock, raises dividend.
newsitem.headline: Marsh & McLennan splits stock, raises dividend.

text.p: Marsh & McLennan Cos. Inc., one of the world's largest insurance brokers, said Wednesday its board declared a two-for-one stock split and raised the company's dividend.

Marsh & McLennan said it would raise its quarterly dividend by 11 percent to $1 from 90 cents on a pre-split basis. The split will raise the company's total shares outstanding to 166 million, from 83 million.
On a post-split basis the quarterly dividend is equivalent to 50 cents a share, it said.
Marsh & McLennan is an insurance, investment management and consulting services company. The company's stock was up $1.25 to $129.875 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
The split affects shareholders of record on June 6, with certificates to be issued on June 27. The dividend is payable on Aug. 15 to stockholders of record on July 11.
